title: Bond Risk Premia
author: Cochrane & Piazzesi
claim: Tent-shaped linear combination of forward rates predicts excess bond returns with R² up to 0.44. Used as the source for the 10y-2y slope-momentum strategy.

title: The TIPS-Treasury Bond Puzzle
author: Fleckenstein, Longstaff, Lustig
claim: Mispricing between TIPS and Treasury STRIPS produces a mean-reverting breakeven inflation series. Source for the TIPS breakeven MR strategy.

title: Betting Against Beta
author: Frazzini & Pedersen
claim: Long low-beta, short high-beta produces positive risk-adjusted returns across asset classes including IG credit. Source for the IG carry low-vol strategy.
